name: search
description: Search Twitter/X for tweets, with optional --from / --has / --exclude / --product filters mapped to X's search operators

positionals.name: query
positionals.help: Search query. Raw X operators (e.g. "exact phrase", #tag, OR, lang:en, since:YYYY-MM-DD, from:, since:) are passed through unchanged.

command_options.name: filter
command_options.help: Legacy alias for --product. Kept for backwards compatibility; if --product is set it wins.

command_options.name: product
command_options.help: Which X search tab to read: top (default), live (Latest), photos, videos. Maps to the f= URL param.

command_options.name: from
command_options.help: Restrict to tweets authored by <user>. Leading @ is stripped. Equivalent to appending `from:<user>` to the query.

command_options.name: has
command_options.help: Restrict to tweets that have media|images|videos|links|replies. Maps to X's `filter:<has>` operator.

command_options.name: exclude
command_options.help: Exclude tweets matching <type>: replies|retweets|media|links. Maps to X's `-filter:<x>` operator (retweets → -filter:nativeretweets).

command_options.name: limit
command_options.help: Maximum number of tweets to return (default 15). Result count after server-side filtering.

command_options.name: top-by-engagement
command_options.help: When set to N>0, re-rank the results by weighted engagement (likes×1 + retweets×3 + replies×2 + bookmarks×5 + log10(views+1)×0.5) and return the top N. Default 0 keeps X's native ordering.

browser_common_options.name: window
browser_common_options.help: Browser window mode: foreground or background

browser_common_options.name: site-session
browser_common_options.help: Adapter site session lifecycle: ephemeral or persistent

browser_common_options.name: keep-tab
browser_common_options.help: Keep the browser tab lease after the command finishes

common_options.name: format
common_options.help: Output format: table, plain, json, yaml, md, csv
